thread:
rachel: SI partner 'QuantumSI' wants to onboard large historical backfills as compressed daily archives (parquet/gz) with minute deltas for marketplace metering. They want a clear SLA for acceptance, replay semantics, and a dispute window.

omar: high-level questions: acceptance window for backfills (how far back do we allow?), canonicalization rules, idempotency across retries, and cost/retention for raw minute storage. Also need contract flag for behavior when device->tenant mapping is missing.

tessa: technical proposal: accept archives with manifest.json containing batch_id, partner_id, timezone, and optional mapping file. Ingest pipeline will: 1) validate schema, 2) expand archive to minute rows, 3) normalize timestamps to UTC, 4) write raw minutes to S3 partitioned by partner/date/batch, 5) publish events to the "metering.raw" topic for attribution workers. Idempotency key = partner_id + batch_id.

luca: sample manifest example they agreed to (sent as text):
```
manifest.json
{
  "partner_id": "quantumsi",
  "batch_id": "qs-20250901-daily-01",
  "tz": "America/Los_Angeles",
  "contains": "minute_parquet",
  "mapping_file": "device_map_20250901.csv" // optional
}
```

omar: policy draft for backfills: allow backfills up to 30 days by default. For older-than-30d, require partner-specific contract approval and manual intake. Late-arrival correction window for billing adjustments will be 48h after the invoice close for that month; after that, adjustments become manual disputes.

tessa: attribution fallback rules:
- if device->tenant mapping present in batch: use it (and persist mapping with 30d TTL)
- if missing: try last-known mapping in our mapping table (48h lookback)
- if still missing: mark minute as AGGREGATE and route to conservative attribution (bill baseline or credit partner depending on contract) and include provenance 'aggregate_fallback'

luca: billing heuristics for hour-level classification we propose (partner-configurable):
- >=50 minutes present: full hour, bill exact sum of deltas
- 25-49 minutes: partial hour, reconstruct missing minutes using partner-specific EMA across last 7d, cap adjustment to 12%
- <25 minutes: unknown, do not bill automatically; open PART ticket and credit partner until resolved

rachel: QuantumSI asked if we can support replay idempotency and a replay API so they can re-send corrected archives; we should support strict dedupe by batch_id and item-level checksum. Also they want a daily audit CSV with provenance columns.

omar: storage/retention note: keep raw minute-level for 14d for typical partners; marketplce partners may opt-in for 30d raw retention for audits. We should surface estimated S3 cost per partner before enabling extra retention. Finance must approve any default >14d.

tessa: testing matrix: compressed archive unpacking, manifest validation failures, mapping-file missing, duplicates (same batch retried), out-of-order minute rows within archive, long-tail late batches (>2h) and full replay scenarios that replace previous batch. Add performance test for 1M minute rows in a single daily archive.

luca: reconciliation and audits: provide a recompute API that can regenerate hourly charges from raw minutes and emit a partner-facing CSV with columns: hour_utc, tenant_id, device_id, raw_sum, attribution_method, confidence_score, source_batch_ids. Include both pre-and-post rounding columns for finance.

billing-bot: Created ticket PART-8033: "QuantumSI bulk archive onboarding + replay + audit CSV" assigned to rachel, omar, tessa, luca. ETA 2025-09-10

rachel: action items:
- tessa: PR for archive contract + ingest validator + idempotency checks (due Fri)
- luca: PoC replay API and recompute script + performance harness (due next Wed)
- omar: partner config knobs (backfill window, retention, partial-hour thresholds) + finance note (due Tue)
- rachel: coordinate QuantumSI acceptance tests and request a 30-day sample backfill into staging (due Tue)

omar: small decisions so far: default backfill window 30d, default raw retention 14d, idempotency by partner_id+batch_id, 48h invoice correction window, UTC-only bucketing. Leave partner_override flags for retention and thresholds.

tessa: will add manifest schema to onboarding docs and include sample mapping CSV format. Also adding a schema-level checksum in the manifest to speed validation.

luca: will include provenance columns in attributed rows: provenance_method (explicit, last_known_map, aggregate_fallback, replay_replace), confidence_score [0-1], source_batch_id(s).

rachel: scheduling a 30m sandbox walkthrough with QuantumSI and eng tomorrow 10am PT. tagging @tessa @luca @omar :calendar:

rachel: thanks everyone. closing thread until acceptance tests pass. :white_check_mark:
